import numpy as np
def read(f):
    L=open(f).read().split('\n'); n=int(L[0]); at=[];xyz=[]
    for l in L[2:2+n]:
        p=l.split(); at.append(p[0]); xyz.append([float(x) for x in p[1:4]])
    return at,np.array(xyz)

la,lx=read('lig.xyz')
ca,cx=read('cym.xyz')
N=7; P=10; C8=8; C9=9
# chelate plane normal
v1=lx[N]-lx[P]; v2=lx[C8]-lx[C9]
nhat=np.cross(v1,v2); nhat/=np.linalg.norm(nhat)
# Ru position: in chelate plane, outside
mid=(lx[N]+lx[P])/2
# direction away from ring interior (from C8-C9 midpoint through mid)
d=mid-(lx[C8]+lx[C9])/2
d-=np.dot(d,nhat)*nhat; d/=np.linalg.norm(d)
# solve for Ru = mid + t*d with |Ru-N|=2.12
import scipy.optimize as so
def f(t):
    R=mid+t*d
    return (np.linalg.norm(R-lx[N])-2.12)**2+(np.linalg.norm(R-lx[P])-2.28)**2
r=so.minimize_scalar(f,bounds=(0,4),method='bounded')
t=r.x; Ru=mid+t*d
print('t',t,'resid',r.fun, np.linalg.norm(Ru-lx[N]),np.linalg.norm(Ru-lx[P]))
uN=(lx[N]-Ru)/np.linalg.norm(lx[N]-Ru); uP=(lx[P]-Ru)/np.linalg.norm(lx[P]-Ru)
uCl=-nhat
Cl=Ru+2.42*uCl
ucen=-(uN+uP+uCl); ucen/=np.linalg.norm(ucen)
cen=Ru+1.72*ucen
print('angles', np.degrees(np.arccos(np.dot(uN,uP))), np.degrees(np.arccos(np.dot(uN,uCl))), np.degrees(np.arccos(np.dot(uP,uCl))))

# cymene: ring atoms indices
# find aromatic ring: from smiles Cc1ccc(C(C)C)cc1 -> atoms 0 C methyl,1..3,4,(5,6,7 ipr),8,9 ring
ring=[1,2,3,4,8,9]
rc=cx[ring].mean(axis=0)
# ring normal
A=cx[ring]-rc
u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(A)
rn=vt[2]
# rotate cymene so rn -> -ucen (ring normal pointing from centroid away? we want normal along ucen axis)
def rotmat(a,b):
    a=a/np.linalg.norm(a); b=b/np.linalg.norm(b)
    v=np.cross(a,b); c=np.dot(a,b)
    if np.linalg.norm(v)<1e-8:
        return np.eye(3) if c>0 else -np.eye(3)
    vx=np.array([[0,-v[2],v[1]],[v[2],0,-v[0]],[-v[1],v[0],0]])
    return np.eye(3)+vx+vx@vx*(1/(1+c))
R1=rotmat(rn,ucen)
cx2=(cx-rc)@R1.T
# in-plane rotation: put the methyl/ipr axis pointing away from P/N side
# choose rotation minimizing clash with ligand: brute force
best=None
e1=cx2[ring[0]]-0; e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1)
for ang in range(0,360,5):
    th=np.radians(ang)
    K=ucen
    vx=np.array([[0,-K[2],K[1]],[K[2],0,-K[0]],[-K[1],K[0],0]])
    Rr=np.eye(3)+np.sin(th)*vx+(1-np.cos(th))*vx@vx
    c3=cx2@Rr.T+cen
    # clash score
    from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
    D=cdist(c3,np.vstack([lx,Cl[None,:]]))
    sc=np.sum(np.clip(2.6-D,0,None)**2)
    if best is None or sc<best[0]: best=(sc,ang,c3)
print('best clash',best[0],best[1])
c3=best[2]
atoms=la+['Ru','Cl']+ca
coords=np.vstack([lx,Ru[None,:],Cl[None,:],c3])
with open('raw.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(f"{len(atoms)}\ncomplex\n")
    for a,c in zip(atoms,coords):
        f.write(f"{a} {c[0]:.6f} {c[1]:.6f} {c[2]:.6f}\n")
print(len(atoms))
idx_Ru=len(la); print('Ru idx',idx_Ru,'Cl',idx_Ru+1,'ring',[idx_Ru+2+i for i in ring])
